d:
"The spaceship Bubbles is a wreck, and not just because its drunken pilot is always crashing it! Why, exactly, did mad scientist Boris hire this dysfunctional crew? This is the first version of Anthronauts, started as an April Fools prank with no plans for the plot beyond page one. It has a lot of darker and heavier plot elements than the reboot." - Artist

Comic started on April 2010 and end/rebooted on July 2013.
